set.body: Implement scale-space localized energy inference for neurothresh. Core contract: low-level scanner consumes stat_vol + mask + null_fun; raw-image wrappers create statistic maps and deterministic null generators. Include identity and global endpoints, Gaussian grid scales, signed coherence and local energy channels, two-pass studentization, max-null FWER over scale x location x channel, resolution-evidence summaries, and later raw-image/GLM/graph extensions. Source plan: specs/scale-space-energy-plan.md.
set.title: Epic: Scale-space localized energy inference
